scope: Original Blue Rescue Team browser reimagining; qualified original-Red source mechanisms and original-shared UPC corroboration. No later-game or DX mechanics.

provenance.qualification: Every species mobility row and algorithm here is pinned-original-Red-comparative unless specifically marked shared-original or independent inference. This is usable implementation evidence, not a claim that all instructions or tables were checked against a Blue binary.
provenance.license: Public source availability does not grant rights to proprietary game assets. Deliverable contains independently stated factual behavior, numerical parameters and identifiers; no original scripts, dialogue, source implementation, tile arrays, art or ROM data. No license conclusion for commercial assets is made.

secondaryCorroboration.scope: Shared original Rescue Team researcher: species movement categories and non-Flying exceptions, move ranges. Not treated as binary-parity proof.
Shared original researcher: wall Belly cost, boss restrictions and projectile/terrain distinctions.

mobilityClasses.name: lava-only
mobilityClasses.effectiveClass: liquid if tileset kind LAVA, otherwise regular

mobilityClasses.name: water-only
mobilityClasses.effectiveClass: regular if tileset kind LAVA, otherwise liquid

navigationContracts.identity: Use actual internal species/form id, not apparent transformed species, current types, Levitate, or a main-series Flying-type test.
notes: All movement classes still reject destination impassable flag. Unbreakable prevents terrain destruction, not necessarily traversal; keep these flags separate.
Tileset NONE follows the non-LAVA branch for water-only mobility. Use the 76-row table, not dungeon display-name inference.

steps: Reject destination out of map, impassable, or occupied by any monster.
Get base effective class from the species table and tileset.

Only if tileset <=63: Mobile status OR usable Mobile Scarf sets wall class; otherwise enabled All-Terrain Hiker sets chasm class; otherwise enabled Super Mobile sets wall on cardinal directions and chasm on diagonal directions. This is an else-if chain, not union of permissions.
Check source-tile neighbor mask for this class and direction.
navigationContracts.diagonalPredicate: For regular/liquid/chasm: destination terrain is allowed by class, and both orthogonal side terrain low-two-bit codes are nonzero. Side occupancy and side impassable flags are not checked here. Wall class ignores side terrain.
navigationContracts.bossException: Boss suppression is tileset >63, not fixedRoomId !=0.
navigationContracts.heldUsability: HasHeldItem requires an existing, nonsticky item; use existing item-effect contract.
counterexamples: A water tile can serve as an orthogonal diagonal corner for an ordinary walker even when that walker cannot enter water.
Native wall species can lose diagonal wall permission when All-Terrain Hiker or Super Mobile takes precedence outside boss tilesets.

rules: Super Mobile can convert a visited wall to floor only if it is neither unbreakable nor impassable. Recompute adjacency for its surrounding 3x3 neighborhood. Mobile status/scarf movement does not perform this conversion.
On secondary lava: thaw Frozen; attempt Burn unless native mobility is4, species is Ho-Oh or Moltres, or actor already has Burn. Burn effect applies its own Fire-type/Water Veil immunity checks.
On other secondary liquid: cure Burn.
A leader in wall terrain pays5 Belly in this terrain hook; do not treat this as ordinary per-turn Belly cost.
navigationContracts.scope: Use status engine action gates separately: rooted/wrapped actors cannot choose a normal step. Traversal ability does not imply immunity to lava effects.

additionalDestinationRejections: House Avoider rejects a Monster House tile while that house has not triggered.
Trap Avoider rejects trap tile if visible or actor has Eyedrops.
Lava Evader rejects secondary terrain in a LAVA tileset.
navigationContracts.then: Apply one-step mobility override order and source neighbor mask; empty target succeeds. Occupied target fails and reports pokemonInFront=true only if terrain otherwise allowed.
navigationContracts.scope: These are AI preferences; do not globally block player input or projectile travel with them.

rules: sub_80703A0 returns blocked for any occupied tile; sub_807049C permits occupancy by a monster but rejects nonmonster entities. Both reject bounds and impassable.

These position checks use Mobile/scarf unless boss tileset; in their base branch IQ All-Terrain Hiker then IQ Super Mobile are separate assignments, with Super Mobile last, even on boss tilesets. They have no diagonal-corner context.

sub_80705F0 accepts any nonwall terrain; it accepts wall under its position-helper Mobile/scarf or native/IQ wall-class rules, and is used for front/two-away move targeting. Do not substitute a walking predicate.
CanCrossWalls tests native wall class or Mobile status or Mobile Scarf only; it does not include Super Mobile or All-Terrain Hiker.
navigationContracts.integration: Keep purpose-specific predicates; a single universal canEnterTile loses source distinctions.

eligibility: Target is a monster and either team member, shopkeeper mode1/2, an experience-locked client, or rescue target.
Neither participant may have Shadow Hold, Frozen, Constriction, Ingrain, Wrap, Wrapped or Confused. Sleep-class status must be None, Sleepless or Yawning. Target must not be charging a two-turn move.
Leader must pass direction mobility check that allows monster occupancy.
steps: If target cannot occupy leader old position by sub_807049C, native asks confirmation.
On accept: mark swapping, assign opposed walking actions, exchange occupancy atomically in browser state; preserve per-actor postmove handling.
Native can allow the unsafe swap after confirmation, followed by normal invalid-terrain relocation handling.
navigationContracts.implementationChoice: Keep an explicit confirmable unsafe-swap action; ordinary directional stepping alone should not silently strand an ally.

navigationContracts.roomBounds: Compute minX,minY,maxXExclusive,maxYExclusive from tiles sharing roomId. Actual sight rectangle is [minX-1,maxXExclusive+1) by [minY-1,maxYExclusive+1). It tests the rectangle, not equal roomId, ray casting, or wall occlusion.
navigationContracts.corridorActualSight: If origin roomId=255, Chebyshev distance <= floor.visibilityRange; stored zero means2.
navigationContracts.extendedTargetSight: Room rectangle first; otherwise distance<=1 succeeds, distance>2 fails. At distance2, walk two sign(dx),sign(dy) steps from each endpoint toward the other. All visited cells in both paths must have nonzero low-two-bit terrain. Impassable flags and diagonal side walls are not tested here.

entityGates.CanSeeTarget: valid viewer and target; target.isVisible; invisible target needs Eyedrops or usable Goggle Specs; viewer Blinker fails; then ActualSight
entityGates.sub_8045A70: valid entities, target.isVisible, then ActualSight; does not apply invisible-status or viewer-Blinker checks

navigationContracts.scope: Do not equate rendered visibility, AI target acquisition, actual room-move selection and tile memory.

navigationContracts.melee: Use effective class at least chasm, so ordinary melee can reach a neighboring creature on water/lava/chasm. Apply the same boss/override precedence and diagonal corner mask as movement; reject impassable; allow monster occupancy. Native wall mobility can attack through walls.

rangeCodes.1: three front-adjacent tiles at facing-1,facing,facing+1; direct entity lookup, no melee corner test
rangeCodes.2: all eight adjacent tiles starting facing then native direction order; direct lookup
rangeCodes.3: active entity order filtered by sub_8045A70 ActualSight; actor self inclusion governed by move flags
rangeCodes.4: first eligible entity at one ahead through sub_80705F0, else eligible entity two ahead if both forward tiles pass that helper; no diagonal side-corner check
rangeCodes.6: all active entities on floor, subject to target category

navigationContracts.categoryFilters: Apply move ally/enemy/self/traitor target contract after geometric eligibility. Room moves actually use the weaker sub_8045A70 gate although AI selection uses CanSeeTarget. Preserve that distinction.

steps: Advance one direction vector per step until configured projectile range exhausted.
Stop outside56x32; ordinary straight projectile stops on low-two-bit wall0. It does not apply walking diagonal corner checks or block on water/chasm.
Impassable flag on an otherwise floor tile is not the wall-stop predicate in this routine.
Piercing mode crosses walls and continues after targets; ordinary mode stops after its first applicable hit.
Bouncy trajectory and Bounce Band use their own redirection before continued stepping.
navigationContracts.scope: Read max steps/piercing/bounce flags from the existing item/move effect contract. Do not hardcode every projectile to ten tiles. Arced stones follow their separate targeting routine and ignore wall ray obstruction.

layoutFamilies.grid: Draw X in[2,8],Y in[2,7], reject X>6 orY>4 up to32 draws; fallback4x4. Cell sizes floor(56/X),floor(32/Y).
construction: Initialize valid grid; AssignRooms; CreateRoomsAndAnchors; random connectivity walk; carve grid connections with merging; ensure connected.
Uses standard stages; invalidate x>=2. Extra hallway eastward walks stop at x>=32.
Carve one52x28 room with roomId0; invoke Monster House selection with chance999; set forceMonsterHouse.
layoutFamilies.validationQuirk: One room fails ordinary two-room validation; after ten inner attempts the same family is used as fallback. House eligibility guards can still suppress its Monster House.

construction: Eight inner4x2 cells are rooms; perimeter cells are one-tile hallway anchors. Carve explicit continuous perimeter ring, add random grid connections, permit merges and ensure connected.

Special room dimensions use RngRange(5,cellWidth-3), RngRange(4,cellHeight-3); origin cell start+2 plus R(range-size), without standard odd/aspect adjustment. Perimeter anchors use cellStart+1+R(cellDimension-3).

Perimeter cells except four invalid corners are rooms; inner3x2 cells are corridor anchors. Connect the three interior columns vertically and two interior rows horizontally. Disable merging; ensure connected.
Special room width RngRange(5,cellWidth-3), height RngRange(4,cellHeight-3), origin start+2+R(range-size), no standard odd/aspect adjustment. Interior anchors use cellStart+1+R(cellDimension-3).

Create two rooms with widths RngRange(10,23), heights RngRange(16,25), origins cellStart+1+R(range-size). Connect left to right with merging enabled. Monster House chance999 chooses one eligible room; set forceMonsterHouse.
Assign rooms/anchors using roomDensity; random connectivity walk; connections with merging disabled; ensure connected.
Mark all cells rooms then invalidate four corners; connect center to four arms. Create standard rooms; no merging; ensure connected.

layoutFamilies.grid: Grid draw X in[2,4],Y in[2,3], otherwise standard large construction.
construction: Same standard stages as layout0; distinct initial grid distribution.

Create nine standard rooms. Connect left-center-right in each row without random merging; merge all three center cells vertically into their enclosing rectangle, retaining first center room ID; topology has six wings and one long center room. Ensure connected.

layoutFamilies.grid: Use standard large grid draw; perimeter cells rooms, interior invalid.
construction: Create standard rooms, assign source perimeter connections, carve with merging, ensure connected.

Native top/bottom connections omit top/bottom corner horizontal edges: for x=0..X-2 set cell(x,top/bottom).right iff x!=0; set cell(x+1,top/bottom).left iff x<X-2. Side-column connections for y=0..Y-2 set top iff y!=0 and bottom iff y<Y-2. Connectivity cleanup/retries resolve degenerate grids.
Standard stages with x>=3 invalid. Extra hallway eastward walks stop at x>=48.

generationContracts.R: For cap>=0, R(cap)=floor(u16*cap/65536); R(0) still draws and returns0. Native general helper also masks final result to16bits.
generationContracts.range: RngRange(a,b)=min(a,b)+R(abs(a-b)); endpoints equal returns that endpoint without a draw; high endpoint exclusive.
generationContracts.nativeStream: Unsigned32 LCG state=1566083941*state+1 modulo2^32; return state>>16. Seed initialized seed|1. Browser seed compatibility is not required.
generationContracts.coordinates: All room rectangles half-open. Integer division truncates. Normal shared grid loops frequently x-major; standard room carving assigns room IDs y-major. Preserve explicitly stated order where it affects selection.
generationContracts.warning: Use accepted byte/signed fields exactly. roomDensity signed negative means fixed count; enemyDensity is read unsigned despite dead negative-density branch.

sequence: Initialize floor-wide globals, secondary structure budget, secondaryGen=false and sSecondSpawn=true.
Up to10 spawn/layout outer attempts. Each begins player/stairs anchors absent.

Within each outer attempt, up to10 geometry attempts. Any inner attempt index>0 zeros secondaryStructuresBudget for the remainder of this generation call. Reset grid/tile state and per-layout shop/house state.
If fixedRoomNumber!=0 call fixed construction. A floorwide fixed layout returns immediately from the inner loop; embedded chambers continue normal geometry validation.

For ordinary layout draw grid (up to32 retries), then select layout code modulo16. Codes12..15 dispatch standard large. Accepted canonical floor rows use raw13 seven times and raw15 twenty times; retain raw IDs and normalize behavior to family0.
After layout: reset inner boundary rows y1,y30; force any impassable tiles to wall; validate at least30 normal room tiles (roomId<=240) and at least2 distinct roomIds<64.
If all10 inner attempts fail, reset floor and create one-room Monster House fallback.
Finalize junctions. If secondaryGen true, run external secondary formations. secondaryGen is set true by eligible family and is not reset per retry.
Draw itemless house flag R(100)<itemlessMonsterHouseChance; nonenemy spawns; enemy spawns; resolve incompatible spawn flags.
Require player anchor. FloorType FIXED accepts without stairs reachability. Other floors require stairs and successful StairsAlwaysReachable. Failure starts next outer attempt.
After all10 outer attempts fail, reset/create one-room Monster House and spawn with itemless=false; source does not rerun normal validation.
Apply Kecleon shop stock rectangle/density and final tile bookkeeping.
generationContracts.sourceCommentConflict: A nearby comment says20 room tiles. The executable C condition is >=30.
generationContracts.floorType: Rescue target floor takes rescue classification first; otherwise fixed IDs1..49 are FIXED. Embedded fixed IDs>=50 are normal floor type.

steps: Draw extra=R(3) even if roomDensity negative. Negative density requests absolute value; nonnegative requests density+extra.
Create256 false flags, set first requested count true; perform64 swaps at positions R(gridX*gridY),R(gridX*gridY).
Visit grid x-major then y; invalid cells do not advance flag cursor. Copy next flag into isRoom.
Odd grid-width special cell (floor(gridX/2),1) is forced not-room after accounting in source room counter.
Source nominal32-room guard can be overwritten by following assignment; accepted grids <=24 cells make this irrelevant.

If counted rooms<2, set the source sSecondSpawn flag false (no consumer in this generation translation unit) and perform up to200 x-major scans, selecting the first valid cell with R(100)<60 to force a room. Final whole-floor validator remains responsible for requiring2 rooms.
generationContracts.selection: Fixed64 random swaps are not a uniform Fisher-Yates shuffle. Do not describe roomDensity as guaranteed final number after connectivity, merges and retries.

room.oddPreference: For each dimension, replace with dimension|1 only if result is strictly less than available dimension.
room.aspectCorrection: Shrink width if > floor(3*height/2), then height if > floor(3*width/2).
room.roomIdOrder: y-major, then x-major; increment only rooms

generationContracts.anchor: One ordinary floor tile with temporary roomId254 (converted during final junction processing). For X: minX=cellStartX+2, rangeX=cellWidth-4; lower=minX+(1 if first column else2), upper=minX+rangeX-(2 if last column else4); choose RngRange(lower,upper). For Y use minY=cellStartY+2, rangeY=cellHeight-3 and analogous first/last row margins.
features: Always draw R(100)<80 for flagSecondaryStructure; then clear the flag if secondaryStructuresBudget==0.
flagImperfect follows roomFlags imperfections. If both flags would be true, a50/50 draw clears one.
generationContracts.boundsSource: Same function lines1574–1717 supplies edge-specific anchor minimum/margin rules; use these if reproducing statistical placement, while standalone fixed chambers only require stated dimensions/gates.

connectionWalk: Random starting valid-grid cursor selection uses R(X),R(Y), not rejection sampling. Initial direction R(4): east,north,west,south.

For each floorConnectivity iteration always draw R(8) and R(4); replace direction iff first<4, else retain momentum. Rotate counterclockwise until direction stays in grid. If target invalid, stay; else mark reciprocal edge and move cursor.
If dead ends forbidden, repeatedly scan valid nonroom anchors with exactly1 edge; try up to8 random directions to add missing valid edge, until no additions.
carving: Sanitize out-of-grid/invalid links. For each cell x-major/y-major choose interior room point or anchor. Process up/down/left/right links.
Each connection is an orthogonal three-leg hallway through the intervening grid boundary coordinate. Each leg has a56-step bound and stops on existing floor after leaving start.

If merging enabled, each eligible room has R(100)<5 opportunity followed by random cardinal neighbor. Merge connected, unmerged, valid room pair without secondary structures; carve enclosing rectangle and preserve source room assignment. Do not treat this as independent9.75% for every pair.
Connectivity repair connects an unconnected room to a connected neighbor in up,down,left,right priority. Remove unused isolated anchors and any still-disconnected rooms.
generationContracts.nativeBug: Dead-end repair checks grid[x+1][y] validity for every chosen direction. At right edge this may read uninitialized grid storage. Native behavior is not a defined portable algorithm.

browserAdaptation.rule: Check the actual chosen neighbor with bounds, add only absent reciprocal valid edges, and stop after a pass adds none. At most2*X*Y-X-Y unique grid edges can be added. Cap boundary rotations at4 and fail attempt if none available.
browserAdaptation.why: Preserves intended dead-end removal and finite generation without emulating uninitialized native memory.

extraHallways: Exactly numExtraHallways attempts; pick grid cell by R(X),R(Y). Require valid connected nonmaze room. Pick an interior tile and cardinal direction, adjusted away from extreme edges.
Walk out of room and past existing floor; abort if secondary terrain is encountered.

Maintain two-tile map margin, avoid side-adjacent floor and2x2 floor squares. Carve a stride of3..5 cells, then turn left/right equally. Stop on collision, impassable terrain, map/size boundary or existing connection. Eastward walks stop at x>=32 in small layout or x>=48 in medium layout.
imperfections: Only flagged, valid, connected unmerged rooms with no maze/secondary feature.60% skip.
Use max(1,(width+height)//4) rounds, with two corner/edge searches per round. Select random corner and clockwise/counterclockwise progression, search at most10 cells for candidate floor.
Reject candidate near corridor within2 tiles or whose four cardinal neighbors do not match the selected corner cutting pattern; otherwise turn floor into wall.
generationContracts.invariant: Imperfections must preserve intended room connectivity; whole-floor validation/retry checks reachability after later stages.

shop: No shop if Monster House already selected, chance0, rescue target floor, or chance<=R(100).
Shuffle each0..14 coordinate list with200 random swaps; scan their Cartesian order for first valid connected room at least5x4, without merged/maze/secondary structure/exclusion flag.
Mark shop interior leaving1-tile room margin; suppress ordinary stairs/monster placements there; keep shop center for keeper.
monsterHouse: No house if shop already exists; chance0 or chance<=R(100); special mission flag unk644.unk44!=0; or floor type not NORMAL.
Candidate must be valid, unabsorbed by merge, connected room, not shop/maze/secondary structure or unk15 exclusion.

One true bit among candidateCount shuffled64 random swaps selects house; enumerate source x-major. Mark every tile in selected room, store room ID. chance999 forces only the probability check, not other guards.
generationContracts.mutualExclusion: Shop runs first, so a successful shop prevents subsequent house selection on that attempt.
generationContracts.itemless: Separate R(100)<itemlessMonsterHouseChance is drawn after geometry and changes initial house spawns, not room identity.

generationContracts.ordinaryMaze: After chance passes, function returns whenever generationAttempt>=0. GenerateFloor sets attempt0..9, so ordinary mazeRoomChance never creates a maze in this pinned source. Do not quietly enable it as if source-backed.
generationContracts.secondaryMaze: Secondary-structure case1 can still invoke maze carving. Seed walls/liquid from every-other border location then every-other interior location; grow by2 tiles in a random cardinal direction, rotate through up to4 choices until a floor destination is found; fill origin/intermediate. Stop when no direction available. Each success consumes floor cells, so bounded by room area.
generationContracts.structureEligibility: Valid non-Monster-House, unmerged room, not imperfect, flaggedSecondaryStructure; only while remaining budget permits actual branch.

branches.effect: Spend1 budget; both room dimensions odd => secondary-terrain maze; otherwise if both>=5 place central plus in5x5 region, else central liquid dot.
Only odd dimensions; spend1 budget,64 random cell picks, turn positions with (localX+localY)%2==1 into secondary terrain.
Only dimensions>=5; four draws between start+2 and end-3 form two sorted coordinate pairs; spend1 budget; fill inclusive rectangle with liquid.

Only dimensions>=6; spend1 budget; central2x2 island, surrounding4x4 secondary moat with corner-cuttable flags; place3 item flags and one Warp Trap; mark special region so ordinary reachability does not reject it.
Spend1 budget then orientation R(2); attempt liquid divider through room center. Abort if any proposed cell is adjacent to corridor, but keep spent budget. Mark one side as special spawn region.

generationContracts.branchDraw: R(6) once for each eligible cell; do not resample a branch that fails dimensions.

generationContracts.qualificationNote: Nonmatching C in pinned Red source; comments link an original Blue comparison scratch at https://decomp.me/scratch/sA4YH. This report uses independently stated semantic behavior, not instruction-level equivalence.
river: Begin at top or bottom equally, x=RngRange(2,54), vertical heading toward opposite edge. Alternate vertical and horizontal chunks of2..7 cells; random horizontal left/right. Only convert eligible wall tiles.

After10..59 steps seed a lake:64 random offsets in[-3,3] around current point, accept if adjacent in8-neighborhood to existing liquid and inside two-tile margin; then7x7 smoothing converts eligible walls with>=4 liquid neighbors.
Stop when reaching existing secondary terrain or leaving vertical bounds.
standaloneLakes: Repeat standaloneLakeDensity attempts; each seeks an eligible interior wall seed in at most200 full-map samples.

On a10x10 local boolean field start border true, interior false;80 random interior choices become true if a cardinal neighbor is true. Remaining false cells produce a compact liquid patch, clipped by map bounds and wall eligibility.
generationContracts.terrainSetter: Never overwrites ordinary room floor, impassable walls, or protected secondary features. Cleanup resets secondary on shops, Monster Houses, unbreakable or stairs tiles to floor; outer rows/columns are forced back to walls as specified by boundary hook.

generationContracts.positionSelection: Enumerate candidate cells x-major/y-major. For repeated placements shuffle with2*count random swaps, draw a start index, consume consecutive indices wrapping. Repeated flags can collapse when requested count exceeds candidate count. Empty lists skip.

densities.buriedItems: If density0 skip; otherwise RngRange(d-2,d+2), no min1 clamp.
densities.monsterHouseItemsTraps: RngRange(candidateCount//2,(8*candidateCount)//10), clamp lower6 and upper maxItemsInMonsterHouse (normally7); each slot R(2) chooses item versus trap, trap additionally requires leader-change capability. Skip entirely if itemless house.
densities.ordinaryEnemies: enemyDensity is unsigned; if >0 max(1,RngRange(d//2,d)), else abs(d). Special mission flag may add1.
densities.forcedHouseEnemies: For forceMonsterHouse, RngRange(7*candidateCount//10,8*candidateCount//10), min1, cap(3*maxMonsInMonsterHouse)//2 (normally18). Empty house uses3*3//2=4 cap.

candidateRules.stairs: normal terrain, roomId!=255, not shop/monster spawn/special spawn/natural junction/unbreakable
candidateRules.houseItemsTraps: normal MonsterHouse room tile not special spawn
candidateRules.ordinaryTraps: normal room, not shop/item spawn/natural junction/unbreakable
candidateRules.leader: normal room not shop/natural junction/unbreakable/item/monster/trap spawn; stairs not explicitly excluded

resolve: Stairs and item spawns remove trap spawn.
generationContracts.integration: These are location/count stages; species/item/trap weighted selection remains the already accepted dungeon pool engine. Later triggered-house reinforcements use a separate contract.

generationContracts.predicate: Flood from stairs over ordinary-floor cells and special CORNER_CUTTABLE-marked cells. Ordinary wall/liquid cells without that flag block. Eight-neighbor expansion uses side-cell blocked bits for diagonals. Any unvisited otherwise required traversable cell without unbreakable flag invalidates floor.
generationContracts.qualificationNote: This is generation validation, not actor mobility. Its corner-cuttable flag does not grant actor passage. Fixed floor type bypasses this test.

steps: Choose target width=max(3,RngRange(3,shopWidth-2)), height analogous. Native loops permit20 tries but clamp guarantees first iteration always succeeds.
Draw shrink rounds RngRange(2,4), i.e.2 or3, reused for X andY. For each axis while rectangle exceeds target dimension, remove left/right or top/bottom strip at50/50; clear shop flag there.
Clear shop flags on natural junctions. Center a3x3 stock template at floor((min+max)/2)-1.
For every template cell still shop, not MonsterHouse/natural-junction: mark item iff templateChance>R(100).

fixedRoomContracts.none: ID0 means ordinary procedural generation; its nonempty pointer is not activated by a floor with fixedRoomNumber0.
fixedRoomContracts.floorwide: IDs1..49: place bounding region at(5,5) in56x32 map, make outside region impassable; retain chasm versus wall presentation as tileset dictates. Boss tileset>=64 forces walls impassable. Fixed floor dimensions and actor/player anchors come from pointer facts; do not reuse a generic boss square.
fixedRoomContracts.embedded: IDs>=50: grid=max(1,56//(width+4)) by max(1,32//(height+4)); AssignRooms; up to64 random cell choices seek isRoom, with final cursor fallback; reserve a cell for chamber dimensions, create ordinary surrounding rooms/anchors and connections from that cell with merging disabled, then insert chamber. Does not call ordinary shop/maze/secondary-room feature passes.
fixedRoomContracts.zeroDimensions: Zero width/height falls back to one-room Monster House. None of the140 extracted pointers have zero dimensions.
fixedRoomContracts.protection: Tile dispatch first sets unbreakable; only breakable-wall action1 clears it. Door and unbreakable are independent semantic fields.
fixedRoomContracts.sourceActionTable: PlaceFixedRoomTile handles terrain/player/stairs/door codes and a204-entry entity metadata table. Special actions67/68/69 take priority over entity indexing. No tile arrays or original geometry are included here.

fixedRoomContracts.generation: Header bit1 defers the chamber inner rectangle (two-cell inset) as impassable unbreakable walls; preserves up to8x8 action records for reveal. This hides the reward until unlocking, even for wall-traversing species.
fixedRoomContracts.use: Key checks only the tile immediately north of the actor, independent of actor facing. It must have door flag0x1000 and remain closed. Restore stored chamber cells excluding one-cell perimeter, mark/reveal them, assign actor room ID, remove door+impassable flags from door; keep unbreakable flag.
fixedRoomContracts.after: Run local adjacency, map/trap visibility refresh. Reward access may still require water or wall mobility according to each chamber accessContract.

fixedRoomContracts.duplicateReward: If the nominal fixed reward already exists in inventory, selected dungeon-team held slots, any recruited roster member held slot, or storage quantity>0, replace it with Link Cable. Existence flag governs bag/team; persistent held test uses itemId!=0. Do not limit this check to the bag.
fixedRoomContracts.actors: Source species actions use current floor encounter pool level lookup, behavior code and fixed spawn. MONSTER_DECOY becomes Poliwag in this helper. Cutscene callbacks may remove or replace those actors; fixed pointer role list alone is not a campaign encounter predicate.
fixedRoomContracts.recruits: Boss/reward recruitment behavior remains the existing campaign/recruitment corpus; do not infer from geometry.

rules: The current floor fixed ID is loaded each visit; story completion does not automatically make its geometry procedural. Choose first/retry/post encounter callback separately.
For dispatch, dojo fixed IDs28..49 normalize to27.

For matching row: if missionKind != source UNK0 use post callback; otherwise if postFlag is set use post; else if retryFlag is set use retry; else use first and set retryFlag unless sentinel NUM_CUTSCENE_FLAGS.
Flags equal NUM_CUTSCENE_FLAGS have no mutable campaign flag; see exact27-row table.

Mt. Freeze mid rest stop chooses alternate source dungeon MtFreezePeak2 when RESCUE_SCENARIO_JOB_LIST[29] is true, otherwise primary MtFreezePeak. Alternate omits Ninetales fifth source floor; canonical playable peak has4 floors and terminal scene is separate.
Dojo native dungeon75..97 maps to shared table52 at source floor (nativeId-75)*3+localFloor; use already accepted source section crosswalk.
fixedRoomContracts.unresolvedBoundary: Campaign callback actor spawning/removal/recruitment/completion is intentionally delegated to existing campaign corpus; this task does not copy commercial cutscene scripts.

fixedRooms.actorQualification: Map has scene anchors; Ninetales and other story actors are created by campaign callbacks, not fixed-map species actions.
Four Poliwag slots are fixed-map placeholders for received Rescue Team Maze team data. Bind the existing special encounter route; do not ship four generic Poliwag as the received team.
